principles: Use time-split/holdout results over in-sample fit.
Do not count correlated market metrics as separate evidence.
RPCI probability distribution is the pace core; conformal set communicates uncertainty.
Queue pressure is explanatory context, not independent confirmation, because queue-derived features also enter the RPCI model.
Horse ability/course/condition/structure layers remain separate; do not collapse into an opaque total score.
Rare horse-level signals are explanatory beta flags until incremental held-out probability improvement is strong enough.

dirt_reverse_flow_top3.definition: previous dirt race, finish<=3, decision in 差し/追込, RPCI>=50

position_push_top3.definition: previous finish<=3 and early-corner to 4C gain >=25% of field

ui_policy.top_summary: market x pace x front-pressure x readability
